claims.object_text: α1 subunit of the P/Q-type calcium channel Cav2.1; globally expressed in the brain and crucial for fast synaptic neurotransmission
claims.quote: This gene encodes the α1 subunit of the P/Q-type calcium channel Cav2.1, which is globally expressed in the brain and crucial for fast synaptic neurotransmission.

claims.object_text: developmental and epileptic encephalopathies; familial hemiplegic migraine type 1; episodic ataxia type 2; spinocerebellar ataxia type 6; developmental delay; ataxia; intellectual disability; autism spectrum disorder; language impairment
claims.quote: The broad spectrum of CACNA1A-related neurological disorders includes developmental and epileptic encephalopathies, familial hemiplegic migraine type 1, episodic ataxia type 2, spinocerebellar ataxia type 6, together with unclassified presentations with developmental delay, ataxia, intellectual disability, autism spectrum disorder, and language impairment.
over half of CACNA1A-related epilepsies are refractory to current therapies.
